column5: The profile page pins itself to the server render snapshot so the refresh it performs never reaches its own UI
column6: src/pages/my-account/profile/index.tsx:76 resolves the user with const user = isSSR() ? initialData : userData - so whenever the app runs in SSR mode (the shipped mode per .env.example) the page reads the frozen getServerSideProps prop and never the Redux store. Everything the page renders and seeds from that value is therefore fixed for the lifetime of the page - the form seed at :89-96 - the reset helper at :115-121 - the demo account check at :106 and the phone helpers at :102-103. The page nevertheless refreshes the user through Redux in four places - refreshUserData at :125-133 dispatches setUserDataRedux and so do the submit handlers at :215 and :271 and :457 - none of which can surface because the page is not reading Redux. The clearest casualty is the feature the comment at :136-137 describes: the visibility listener at :138-152 exists to reflect email verification the moment the customer returns from their inbox. Its guard at :139 and its dependency array at :152 both read user?.email_verified_at from the frozen prop so the value can never change - the refresh runs and updates Redux and the page keeps rendering the original verification state.

column14: A feature written specifically to make verification feel instant does nothing in the shipped mode - customers verify their email and are told they have not. The same pinning silently discards the three other Redux refreshes the page performs after its own writes.
column15: Read the user from Redux with the SSR prop as the initial value rather than choosing one source permanently - hydrate the store from initialData on mount and then select from Redux everywhere so every refresh the page already performs takes effect.

column5: The checkout keeps a copy of the selected address that is never reconciled against the address list so edits and deletions leave it stale
column6: checkout.selectedAddress holds a full Address object copied at selection time - src/components/Cart/AddressSection.tsx:152 dispatches setSelectedAddress(selectedAddr) with the object found in the local list. Nothing reconciles that copy afterwards. The addresses screen refreshes only its own SWR list after every mutation - handleEditAddress and handleDeleteAddress and handleAddressAdded at src/pages/my-account/addresses/index.tsx:101-111 each call mutate() and nothing else - so an address edited or removed there leaves the checkout copy untouched. The only clearing anywhere is the initial mount effect at AddressSection.tsx:86-91 which resets the selection to null once per mount - it is not a reconciliation and it does not run while the section stays mounted. Editing the selected address is the damaging case because the stale copy is what the checkout renders and what feeds the market resolution: the confirm handler at :153-155 passes selectedAddr.country_code into resolveMarketForCountry so a country corrected on the addresses screen is not reflected and the cart is recomputed against the previous market.

column14: The customer reviews an order against address text that no longer matches the stored record - and where the country changed the cart is priced in the wrong market. The order itself ships correctly because handleCheckout submits only address_id so the damage is to what the customer is shown and to the currency they are charged in.
column15: Store the selected address id rather than a copy and derive the object from the address list at render so it cannot drift - or if the copy is kept re-sync it whenever the list revalidates and clear it when the selected id is no longer present.
